<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$verify-work-proportionally</code></p>

Choose and run verification proportional to impact, uncertainty, reversibility, and audience. Use when tests alone are insufficient, review coverage needs proof, independent checking helps, or user acceptance is required.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link verify-work-proportionally --scope user
arcantry skills link verify-work-proportionally --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link verify-work-proportionally --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Learning outcomes

- Map material risks to static, automated, live, independent, or user verification.
- Separate verified behavior from plans, assumptions, and unverified acceptance.

## Examples

### Verify a risky implementation

**Prompt**

> Use $verify-work-proportionally to choose and run appropriate checks for this cross-cutting implementation.

**Expected outcome**

Each material risk has an observable check and the final report states exact verified coverage.

### Decide whether user approval is needed

**Prompt**

> Use $verify-work-proportionally to determine which remaining acceptance points require the user's judgment.

**Expected outcome**

Only irreducible product, taste, privacy, or authorization decisions are returned to the user.
